svg.title: NCR four-city masterplan, 4 by 4 kilometres
svg.desc: Original fictional level design: Delhi northwest, Gurugram southwest, Ghaziabad northeast, Noida southeast. Sixteen major destinations, five river crossings and a 600 metre Delhi production slice.
